title: Orennia
description: orennia.com Orennia is a Canadian energy intelligence platform founded in 2021 in Calgary, providing data analytics for solar, wind, battery storage, hydrogen, carbon capture, transmission and crypto mining sectors. With 116 employees and 1,000 plus platform users, it has raised 35 million dollars from General Catalyst and other investors, generating estimated revenue of 18.7 million dollars with 30 percent annual growth. Led by founder and CEO Brooke Coleman, its platform combines project databases, market intelligence, interconnection queue tracking and AI-powered predictive analytics. Clients include utilities, renewable developers, private equity, hedge funds and banks across North America. Its unique Interconnection Queue Tracker covers every major grid operator in the US and Canada. The company is based in Calgary with a second office in Toronto and competes with Enverus, Wood Mackenzie and Bloomberg NEF.
